items.title: AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Deemed Ineligible by Academy for Best Animated Feature Oscar
items.excerpt: The Academy has ruled Gossip Goblin's AI-generated feature 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' ineligible for the Best Animated Feature Oscar race, ahead of its Dec. 4 theatrical release.

items.title: AI Films From Kerala to the Andaman Islands Set for WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon, Screen at IFFI Goa
items.excerpt: Five films made with Google Flow were selected for WIF India's first AI Filmathon from 850-plus registrations and will screen at IFFI Goa.

items.title: Rian Johnson, a Vocal AI Critic, Warns Against Totally 'Demonizing' AI
items.excerpt: Rian Johnson discusses where he draws the line on AI in filmmaking, his Warner Bros. deal and new sci-fi thriller, and confirms the 'Poker Face' revival is dead.

items.title: AI filmmaking: how director Perry Bhandal works solo using gen AI tools
items.excerpt: Indie filmmaker Perry Bhandal, who released the AI-generated feature 'Okay, It's Time To Go', gives a detailed first-hand account of what solo gen-AI feature production actually involves versus his 18-day conventional shoots.

items.title: Maxon Plus Intros New AI-Assisted Tools and 3D Review Services
items.excerpt: Maxon launched Maxon Plus, a suite of connected services including a Model Generator that turns text or a reference image into a 3D base model and a Texture Generator, integrated with Cinema 4D and ZBrush, plus browser-based 3D review.

items.title: Boris FX releases Silhouette 2027
items.excerpt: The VFX rotoscoping and paint tool adds new machine-learning nodes such as Body ML that generate editable roto shapes, and a Video Inpaint ML node to speed up object removal.

items.title: How We Built CorridorKey 2.0 | Live Demo & Q&A
items.excerpt: Niko and developer Zach Harris break down how Corridor built CorridorKey 2.0, the AI keying tool running on a custom-trained model, with a live demo.

items.title: We Found a Wild AI Video Conspiracy...
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge tests Topview's T1 video model against ByteDance Seedance 2.5 and finds matching voices, music, lookalike characters and export metadata suggesting T1 may be a Seedance reskin.

items.title: 'I've lost her forever': Why German voice actors are refusing to sign Netflix's AI contract
items.excerpt: An AI clause in Netflix's German dubbing contracts, which comes with a pay rise, is splitting the dubbing industry over whether it protects performers or allows their voices to be used for AI training.

items.title: 심형래 감독, AI 기술로 깨운 '디 워: NEW HOPE' 2027년 재개봉 예고
items.excerpt: 심형래 감독이 힉스필드AI와 협력해 AI 영상 기술로 30분 분량의 미공개 액션 장면을 추가한 '디 워: NEW HOPE'를 2027년 국내외 재개봉한다고 밝히고 예고편을 공개했다.

items.title: 수백 명 대신 10명…AI가 재편하는 영화산업의 셈법 [AI가 바꾸는 콘텐츠 산업①]
items.excerpt: 25일 개봉하는 AI 장편 '라파엘'의 제작사 마테오AI스튜디오는 수백 명이 필요했을 촬영을 10명 안팎으로 제작해 인력 규모를 10분의 1로 줄였다고 밝혔다. AI가 바꾸는 영화 제작비·인력 구조를 짚는다.

items.title: 이제이비전, AI 인터랙티브 숏드라마 '아쿠아리움 관리자를 위한 지침서' 공개
items.excerpt: 이제이비전이 시청자 선택에 따라 전개가 갈리는 생성형 AI 인터랙티브 숏드라마 '아쿠아리움 관리자를 위한 지침서'를 공개했다.
